_note: Tier 2, oldest end. The 15 June 2025 session, two days into the Israel-Iran war.

mentions.claim_text: He says the marches so far are not as bad as what he sees, that there are a lot of people but nothing police cannot handle, and introduces what he was shown while driving around praying.
mentions.quote: the marches so far not too incredibly bad for what I see
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an assessment of protests already under way, the No Kings marches of 14 June 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is only the beginning of what is about to happen and that he saw a named financier behind the scenes, with his wife and son recording what he was given over more than an hour.
mentions.quote: this is just the beginning of what's about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: Escalation beyond the June 2025 protests, organised and funded.
mentions.falsify_miss: The protests stay at that level or subside. Naming a financier is an allegation offered without support.

mentions.claim_text: He says something was shot above the United States and that the Golden Dome is needed as soon as possible, and describes being shown stationed green laser weapons in corners of the country for protection.
mentions.quote: The Lord showed me stationed electric lasers in all kinds of corners
mentions.falsify_match: Ground-based directed energy weapons deployed across the United States for air defence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None deployed. Note the Golden Dome programme was announced publicly on 20 May 2025, three weeks before this.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be confusion and craziness in America, recalls the ants within and Trojan horse attacks, and reports being told again that in a 24-hour period everything is going to change.
mentions.quote: In a 24-hour period everything's going to change
mentions.falsify_match: A single day in which the American situation is transformed.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such day. The 24-hour frame has no start date attached, so it cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He says an uprising and a cancer within the country will take away the ordinary freedom to go to a baseball game, making people uneasy about security and safety.
mentions.quote: trying to take away that freedom of peace
mentions.falsify_match: Attacks at ordinary public events changing how Americans attend them.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such change. Undated and without a threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great shaking and an invasion are coming to America one day, that most people have no idea, and that he will probably be the only prophetic voice of intercession on it.
mentions.quote: A great shaking and invasion's coming
mentions.falsify_match: An invasion of the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. One day removes any window, so the claim cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He warns against smooth-lipped men saying everything is fine, invokes Jeremiah warning of what was coming, and says the Lord told him to say again that a window has been given.
mentions.quote: Remember Jeremiah when he warned what was coming
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a defence of his own role against reassuring voices.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them Turkey would beat their war drums and will be involved soon, and that he saw Damascus becoming a ruinous heap.
mentions.quote: you would see Turkey beating their war drums
mentions.falsify_match: Turkish entry into the war and the destruction of Damascus.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Damascus as a ruinous heap is Isaiah 17 rather than a new word.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them for months that they would attack Iran's infrastructure until it was crippled, and that Iran is an unwanted red-headed stepchild whom others will not really back.
mentions.quote: Iran is an unwanted red-headed stepchild
mentions.falsify_match: Iran's allies declining to intervene as its infrastructure is struck.
mentions.falsify_miss: They intervene. This is said two days into the strikes, so the infrastructure half is description rather than forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the Vatican split with whitening and a demonic spirit trying to come on a man to influence him badly, states he does not know the year, and says that if it happens it does not happen this year but is coming.
mentions.quote: I don't know the year. I have to say that
mentions.falsify_match: A schism at the Vatican, with the pope under malign influence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. To his credit he states the limit outright: he does not know the year and rules out the current one.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what North Korea is planning while quiet and whether America is involved, and says he told them Trump and Kim would be like Jonathan and David in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: I told you they'd be like a Jonathan and a David
mentions.falsify_match: A close personal alignment between the American and North Korean leaders.
mentions.falsify_miss: None forms. Note this sits against his own godfather-and-hitman claim of six weeks earlier, in which North Korea is the party that attacks America.

mentions.claim_text: He says named financiers are trying to bring instability to America so that people will not want to gather for worship, including through a new virus, and that this is Satan's answer to God assembling the bride for major services.
mentions.quote: trying to bring instability in America so that people wouldn't want to worship
mentions.falsify_match: A new virus or unrest that suppresses church attendance in America.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The attribution of motive to named individuals is an allegation offered without support.

mentions.claim_text: He says that after the shot heard around the world he saw an exposing at a megachurch in California, that a major scandal is about to break loose there, and tells viewers to watch California.
mentions.quote: A major scandal is going to come out. Watch in California
mentions.falsify_match: A major scandal breaking at a California megachurch.
mentions.falsify_miss: None breaks. Bethel Church in Redding suspended Ben Armstrong on 15 February 2026, eight months later, which is the nearest candidate and is scored under church-cleansing.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told that Pearl Harbor was a surprise nobody saw coming, and being told to watch Omaha.
mentions.falsify_match: A significant event at Omaha, which houses US Strategic Command at Offutt Air Force Base.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named city with nothing attached, but the city is an unusual and specific choice.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a mega bomb or huge missile, believes it came from Russia, and asks whether they have ballistic missiles, saying they are about to use big weapons rather than small rockets.
mentions.quote: This is a mega huge missile and I believe they got it from Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Iran using a Russian-supplied ballistic missile of unusual size against Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Iran had been firing ballistic missiles at Israel since 2024, so the category is not new.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they have supersonic missiles for what Israel is about to inflict, and says it is in retaliation.
mentions.quote: Do they have supersonic missiles for what's about to be inflicted
mentions.falsify_match: Hypersonic or supersonic missiles used in the exchange.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. Posed as a question rather than stated, which limits what it commits to.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees strategic people fleeing Iran for Iraq to hide, and repeats it as something someone listening needs to know.
mentions.quote: I see strategic people fleeing from Iran going to Iraq
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian senior figures relocating to Iraq during the strikes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do. Specific enough to check if any account of the war addresses it.
